l1_words.meaning: to intend (to plan to do something)
to watch (a show, a film or a match)

pattern_explanation: Several Portuguese words look almost identical to English words but have a different meaning, so a learner may trust the familiar form and choose the wrong English equivalent.
false_friend_warning: This pair is a false friend trap: the Portuguese word looks like an English word, so the student may assume the meanings match, but the real English meaning is different and must be learned separately.
